Typing "cooking" narrowing down to just the cooking-related links as I type feels natural — that's exactly how I'd want to hunt something down. Keeping them as the same cards, newest first, is fine too.

On the scope, one thing I'd want to make sure of: I don't just want it looking at the title and description. When I search, I'd also expect it to find a link by any personal note I've jotted on it, and by the web address itself — sometimes all I remember is part of the site name. So as long as search covers those too — the title, the description, my own notes, and the address — this is right.
